verdict.rationale: Ollama has a hosted cloud tier for running larger models with an API key, and a pricing page with tier-style feature lines such as concurrency and "more usage". The evidence never states actual prices, tier names, rate limits, or usage caps, so a power-user cannot learn the limits from this pack. Missing for 10: explicit pricing tiers and prices, documented rate limits, documented usage caps or quotas, independent corroboration of cloud limits.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier

citations.quote: Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download.
Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
